name: scrcpymac-phone-agent
description: Open and control your Android phone in a native Codex widget with a standalone H.264 runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Open your Android phone inside Codex
interface.longDescription: Open an interactive ScrcpyMac workspace directly in Codex without installing or launching ScrcpyMac.app. The plugin owns a continuous H.264 scrcpy stream and control session, with 30/60 FPS and 50/75/100% resolution controls, plus screenshots, UI automation, app launching, and WeChat workflows.
defaultPrompt: Open ScrcpyMac for my connected Android phone.
Use ScrcpyMac Phone Agent to check my connected Android device.
Use ScrcpyMac Phone Agent to send a WeChat message.
